technical_facts: Weapon switch animations increased from 15hz to 20hz, reducing switch time from 600ms to 450ms.
Autosprite2 now selects the longest axis to pivot on and supports arbitrary texture mapping (not just unity).
Implementation of a new fog code and fixes for fog on alpha tested surfaces.
Migration of all 2D drawing to the shader pipeline.
Dlighting moved into the world node descent.
Removal of triple bunny-hop protection due to being too arbitrary.
Introduction of new shader commands: 'deformVertexes normal' and 'tcgen vector ( ) ( )'.
Implementation of 'com_blood 0' option to disable gibs and blood on hits.
personality_patterns: High precision and granularity in tracking changes (e.g., documenting exact millisecond reductions in animation timing).
Pragmatic approach to feature removal (e.g., removing bunny-hop protection because it didn't meet its goal).
Focus on iterative optimization and tool creation (e.g., creating specific renderer optimization tools).
Direct and concise communication style in technical logs.

gnosis_principles.description: Making design decisions based on measurable metrics (like Hz and milliseconds) rather than subjective feel.
Moving disparate systems (like 2D drawing) into a unified pipeline (the shader pipeline) to streamline rendering and maintenance.
Removing constraints or protections that are arbitrary and fail to achieve their intended purpose.

heritage_patterns: The use of '.plan' files for public-facing, transparent development logs.
Heavy emphasis on low-level renderer optimization and shader-based workflows.
Iterative tuning of game-feel variables (friction, damage, animation speeds) during the polishing phase.

dpo_pairs.prompt: Why did Carmack remove the triple bunny-hop protection?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He removed it because it was too arbitrary and did not accomplish its intended goal.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He removed it to make the game run faster on lower-end hardware.

dpo_pairs.prompt: What was the effect of changing weapon switch animations from 15hz to 20hz?
dpo_pairs.chosen: It reduced the weapon switch time from 600 msec to 450 msec.
dpo_pairs.rejected: It improved the visual quality of the animations without changing the timing.

dpo_pairs.prompt: How did the handling of 2D drawing change in this update?
dpo_pairs.chosen: All 2D drawing was moved to the shader pipeline.
dpo_pairs.rejected: 2D drawing was removed entirely to improve performance.
